info.title: EnrichMINT API
info.description: Helps people earn from their real-life experience, while helping others learn from it.

headline.example: Former support lead, now freelance onboarding consultant

background.description: Your background in your own words. Shown on your guides.

responsePriceCents.description: Price of a personalized written response, in cents.

acceptanceWindowH.description: Hours you have to accept or decline a request.

deliveryH.description: Hours you have to deliver after payment is confirmed.

boundaries.description: Topics you will and will not answer.

agentAssistAllowed.description: Whether AI may read this guide to help people who bought it. Reading access for buyers is separate and always included.

note.description: Required when rejecting: what the contributor should change.

goalId.description: The goal whose budget this purchase counts against.

approved.description: Must be true: the buyer reviewed the price and approved this payment.

isFollowUp.description: True when this answers the follow-up question for `key`.

priceCents.description: Guide price in cents. Can be changed before submitting.

text.example: My support role is changing because of AI. I want to explore freelancing but I do not know where to start. I have weekends free.

budgetCents.description: Total you are willing to spend on this goal, in cents.

goalId.description: Goal for situation context and the budget shown with any request offer.

guideId.description: The guide whose contributor you want to ask.

share.description: Only items with share=true are ever shown to the contributor.

approved.description: Must be true: you reviewed what will be shared and the price.

aiUseAllowed.description: Whether the learner’s AI assistant may read this response to help them apply it. It stays private either way.

targetId.description: Guide id, or request id for a personal response.

nextStep.description: Immediate: did it help you identify a next step?

tried.description: Follow-up: did you try the guidance?

usefulAfter.description: Follow-up: was it useful after applying it?

goalId.description: An existing goal. Or send text and budgetCents to create one.

budgetCents.description: Total budget for the goal, in cents.

sourceId.description: Guide id, or request id for a personal response.

body.description: What you tried and what happened.

approved.description: Must be true: you agree to publish this note on the guide page and to the assistant.

payoutEmail.description: PayPal (sandbox) email for field note shares, if you have none on file.
